g.title: ibstat on all 8 rails: Physical state = LinkUp ?
State = Active and Base lid != 0 on every rail ?

Exit 4
g.text: Marginal link: rate, not total, matters.

g.title: Exit 6
g.text: Fix the flagged stage: dup GUIDs,

g.title: ib_write_bw -q 4 per rail pair >= ~97% of line rate ?
Fabric is healthy: climb to the application
